sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup and imports
sections.what: Marks the file as browser-only and loads the links, state, image, lazy wrapper, reveal wrapper, data, hover check, layout type, and mode.
sections.why: The card needs each of these parts.

sections.name: imageBox
sections.title: Picture shapes for each layout
sections.what: Maps each of the six layout names to a grid position and picture shape.
sections.why: Keeps each layout's picture size in one table.
sections.watch_out: A missing layout name would break the card.

sections.name: textBox
sections.title: Text placement for each layout
sections.what: Maps each of the six layout names to where the title and text sit.
sections.why: Keeps text placement in one table.
sections.watch_out: Text placement must match the picture placement or the card will look uneven.

sections.name: ProjectPreview (part 1)
sections.title: Picture and reveal behaviour
sections.what: Builds the picture. On touch devices a tap toggles the reveal. Otherwise the whole picture is a link to the project.
sections.why: Touch devices cannot hover, so tap is used instead.
sections.watch_out: Hover and touch behaviour are separate branches, so a change must be made in both.

sections.name: ProjectPreview (part 2)
sections.title: Title, text, and link
sections.what: Shows the number, category, and type, the title link, the punchline in plain mode or the technical summary in technical mode, and a View link.
sections.why: The text changes with the mode.
sections.watch_out: The technical text is built from the system label and tags.

summary: One project card on the home page: a picture in one of six layouts, with the project name, category, and a short line.
purpose: Shows each project in the work list on the home page.
why: Six layouts keep the list visually varied.
how: Looks up the layout's grid position and shape, builds the picture, then places the title and text beside it. On touch screens a tap reveals the picture. Otherwise the whole picture links to the project.
inputs: A project, a layout name, and the project's position in the list.
outputs: A card with an image, number, category, type, name link, short text, and a View link.
risks: A layout name that is missing from the lookup tables would break the layout. Mode changes the text shown.
debug: If a card is misplaced, check its layout name in both lookup tables. If the picture does not link, check the hover detection. If the text is wrong, check the mode setting.
